note: Pinned identities of the benchmark-only competitor tools used in the owned-vs-competitor differentials. Competitors are comparison data only; they never gate the build. Each differential captures the tool's actual reported version at runtime and logs it against the pinned version here; a mismatch warns but never fails. When a benchmark CI workflow installs a competitor (issue #1043 lane), it must install the version pinned here so the committed head-to-head numbers stay reproducible.

gitleaks.scope_notes: Invoked as `gitleaks detect -s <dir> --no-git -f json`; compared per file. The default rules carry provider-format rules that match the corpus's AWS/GitHub/GitLab/Slack/Stripe/GCP/SendGrid planted formats. gitleaks models the false-positive traps only through entropy and allowlist heuristics, not an explicit non-secret label, so trap handling is the primary axis of difference.

checkov.ruleset: default built-in policies (Terraform and Kubernetes frameworks)
checkov.scope_notes: Invoked as `checkov -d <dir> --compact -o json --quiet`; compared per category by the checkov check id (CKV_AWS_*/CKV_K8S_*) that represents each category, so an unrelated policy firing on the fixed fixture is not counted as a false positive for that category.
